title: SharedMemberFileTypeRequest
description: One member workflow's File Type and/or hidden findings, with the tenant that owns it.

workflowId.description: The member credentialing workflow to write.

tenantId.description: The tenant that owns the member workflow.

fileType.description: The file type to set; leave out for a hide-only save.

reason.description: Why the file type changed; at most 1000 characters. Required for NON_CLEAN; for CLEAN while a finding stays unhidden; and for either value when the member's verdict could not be evaluated or there is none. Not needed for a hide-only save.

hiddenFindingRuleKeys.description: The full set of finding rule keys (findings[].ruleKey on the members read) to hide from the PSV packet. Leave out to keep the current hides; send [] to remove them all. At most 50 non-blank keys, each a current finding's rule key.
